enable_deny.description: Whether to enable the 'deny' limit (if set, overrides default deny=0).

deny.description: Number of failed login attempts before the account is locked out.

unlock_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which a locked account is automatically unlocked. Set to 0 for manual unlock only.

fail_interval.description: Time window (in seconds) during which failed attempts are counted toward lockout.

dir.description: Directory where faillock state files for each user are stored.

audit.description: If true, log lockout/unlock events to the systemd journal; otherwise, log only to syslog.

silent.description: If true, suppress faillock-related messages (e.g., 'Account locked') from being printed to the user.

deny_root.description: If true, apply lockout policy to the root account as well. By default, root is excluded.

preauth.description: If true, count failures from PAM pre-authentication stages (e.g., SSH public key rejection) toward lockout.

deny_users.description: List of usernames that should be exempt from faillock lockout entirely.

deny_groups.description: List of group names whose members are exempt from faillock lockout.

allow_users.description: List of usernames that are exempt from being locked out — they still count toward the deny threshold but never lock.

allow_groups.description: List of group names whose members are exempt from lockout.

items.description: Group name whose members should not be locked
